pr_title: planner: invalidate cached plan if no UnionScan for tables that need it (#15429)
pr_body:
Cherry-pick PR
---

<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:

2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #14969 <!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

Problem Summary:
Plan cache mechanism is broken across transaction boundary, i.e, when UnionScan is needed for tables.

### What is changed and how it works?

What's Changed:

Collect `TableInfo` and whether it has been built `UnionScan` during plan building, and store this map into `StatementContext`, then this map is further stored into LRUCache when the plan is put into cache. In `getPhysicalPlan`, if the cached plan contains no `UnionScan` for any query table which has been modified in the transaction, invalidate this cached plan and build a new one.

How it Works:

It can solve cases where the table needs `UnionScan` but the plan doesn't contain one, for cases where the table does not need `UnionScan` but the plan contains one, it does not impact result, so I don't invalidate those plans for a higher cache hit ratio.

### Related changes

N/A

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- Unit test

Side effects

- Performance regression
    - Consumes more MEM: an additional small map is stored in plan cache for each plan

### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->
- Fix wrong result for some cached plans used in transaction.

issue_context.title: prepare plan cache is broken across transaction boundary
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

1. What did you do?
If possible, provide a recipe for reproducing the error.

```
mysql> create table t(a int not null);
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.01 sec)

mysql> prepare stmt from "select * from t where a > ?";
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)

mysql> set @p = 0;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)

mysql> execute stmt using @p;
Empty set (0.01 sec)

mysql> begin;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)

mysql> insert into t values(1);
Query OK, 1 row affected (0.00 sec)

mysql> execute stmt using @p;
Empty set (0.00 sec)

mysql> rollback;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)
```

2. What did you expect to see?

The second `execute` should return `1`.

3. What did you see instead?

It returns nothing, because it reuses the plan without `UnionScan`. Note that, to reproduce this bug, you'd better have enough free memory, otherwise the plan inserted into cache may be removed to reduce memory usage.


4. What version of TiDB are you using (`tidb-server -V` or run `select tidb_version();` on TiDB)?
```
master: 0f9a973e96a442c14a9f292fd2d329491a014518
```
